Congress exempted electric co-ops from federal regulations governing the attachment of cable, telecommunications and broadband service equipment to existing utility poles. Co-op pole attachment rates are cost-based and locally regulated. This protects critical power equipment while ensuring the co-op can work with interested attachers to help bring these services to local consumer-members. Congress should maintain this exemption.
